span.p:
Confirmed DKA:
glucose 200+, ketones 3.0+,
pH under 7.3 / HCO3 under 18

div.style: color: rgb(219, 234, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fluids: 0.9% saline
1 L in first hour
15-20 mL/kg/hr

div.style: color: rgb(254, 243, 199) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Hold insulin,
give KCl 10-20 mEq/hr
until 3.3+

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Add 20-30 mEq KCl
per litre fluid

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
No potassium yet,
recheck in 2 h

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
IV insulin infusion
0.1 unit/kg/hr
fixed rate

div.style: color: rgb(254, 243, 199) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(219, 234, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Add D5 to fluids,
keep insulin running
to clear ketones

div.style: color: rgb(254, 243, 199) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Resolution:
ketones under 0.6,
pH over 7.3,
HCO3 15+?

div.style: color: rgb(241, 245, 249) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Overlap SC basal insulin
1-2 h before stopping drip,
patient eating
